summary: Full certification test of Client→Designer flow. All 14 test scenarios PASS. JourneyWelcomePage now shows CTAs ('Accedi al tuo Atelier™' always, 'Visualizza le Direzioni™' when has_directions=true) and directions section. All backend endpoints verified. Flow: begin-journey → companion → share directions → client sees directions → client leaves feedback — fully working.

A1_BeginJourney.details: POST /api/public/journeys/initiate returns welcome_token, journey_id, lead_id. Required field is 'welcome' object with first_name+email.

A2_WelcomePage_CTAs.details: JourneyWelcomePage renders data-testid: welcome-page, welcome-hero, welcome-cta-panel, welcome-cta-atelier ('Accedi al tuo Atelier™'). All testids present and visible.

A3_Companion_Endpoint.details: GET /api/public/journeys/welcome/{token}/companion returns journey_id, lifecycle_state, concept_directions[], has_directions. Returns has_directions=true after share.

A4_ClientPortal_Companion.details: GET /api/client/journeys/{jid}/companion returns full journey data: header, active_chapter, shared_directions, evolution_timeline.

A5_DesignerSharesDirections.details: POST /api/journeys/{jid}/concept-directions/{set_id}/share returns shared_at timestamp, boards count, email object. Works correctly.

A6_ClientSeesDirections.details: GET /api/client/journeys/{jid}/concept-directions returns sets with set_shared_at. After sharing, returns 1 set with 3 directions.

A7_ClientFeedback.details: POST /api/client/concept-directions/{moodboard_id}/feedback accepts {reaction, text}. Returns feedback object with narrative. Required field: 'reaction' (not 'sentiment').

B1_Prospects.details: GET /api/relations/prospects returns data[] with journey_lifecycle_state and journey_id per prospect. Count: 12+.

B2_Accounts.details: GET /api/relations/accounts returns data[] with journey_lifecycle_state and journey_id. Count: 17.

B3_WelcomeNotDeadScreen.details: Welcome page has 'Accedi al tuo Atelier™' CTA always visible. No longer a dead screen.

B4_AccessPageRenders.details: /access renders 'Accedi al tuo spazio progettuale' with email form and CONTINUA button.

B5_WelcomeWithDirections.details: After sharing directions, welcome page shows: welcome-cta-directions ('Visualizza le Direzioni™ 3 direzioni') AND welcome-directions-section with 3 direction cards. Full B5 flow verified.
